about_the_game:
Military Logistics Simulator puts you behind the wheel of real-world military logistics. Rise from a low-ranking soldier to a seasoned quartermaster as you manage vehicles, expand your base, and take charge of critical supply lines. Deliver vital cargo and defend it from drone attacks, rescue survivors, and help rebuild a war-torn region after conflict — all in immersive first-person simulation. Play solo or with friends and earn your place, leading military operations from behind the lines.

Transport, deploy, and maintain critical military infrastructure — from air defense systems to artillery logistics and UAV operations — across high-risk zones.

Operate and maintain a wide range of real-world military vehicles, including recon trucks, heavy transporters, UAV carriers, and recovery units.

Complete high-value contracts to earn funds, upgrade your fleet, expand your base, and invest in new and better buildings and infrastructure to unlock new vehicles and missions.

Command your loyal German Shepherd to assist in search-and-rescue missions and send him out to sniff out explosives.

Team up with friends to run large-scale logistics operations and play the captivating story together!
